jobs.title: Executive Director- Sycuan Health Center
jobs.description:
The Sycuan Band of the Kumeyaay Nation
is seeking an experienced and visionary Executive Director
to lead the Sycuan Health Center (SHC
). This executive leadership role is responsible for overseeing the strategic direction, operations, financial management, and growth of health programs serving Sycuan and the surrounding community.

This is an excellent opportunity for a healthcare leader who is passionate about improving community health outcomes, building strong partnerships, and advancing innovative healthcare services within a culturally centered environment.

Job Purpose:

Oversees the direction and implementation of health programs serving members of the Sycuan Band of the Kumeyaay Nation and the surrounding community

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

(Duties and responsibilities may be added, deleted, or changed at the sole discretion of Sycuan management at any time.)
Plans and administers the delivery of health services as approved by the Tribal Council
Develops and maintains close interagency working relationships with Federal, State and local public officials, executives of community based organizations, and community leaders and groups
Oversees the operation of the Sycuan Health Center within the framework and policies established by the Tribal Council
Reviews, evaluates and monitors the performance and achievements of the SHC, its personnel and consultants, for compliance with overall program objectives
Implements and maintains policies and procedures to ensure the confidence and privacy of the Tribal Council, staff and patient communications and records
Recommends policy changes as needed to the Tribal Council
Provides periodic and on-going reports to the Tribal Council on the operations, challenges, opportunities, fiscal condition and future projections of SHC
Recommends and implements, within budgets and policies established by the Tribal Council, procedures that will facilitate achievement of SHC established goals and objectives
Recommends SHC plans and goals to secure revenue opportunities that will support the approved budget
Reviews Health Center budgets with Financial Operations Controller in preparation for Tribal Council review
Monitors staff performance, provides team members with regular feedback and performance appraisals and conducts disciplinary actions as needed
Establishes staffing requirements and interviews and selects qualified candidates as needed
Negotiates with funding organizations to optimize SHC funding opportunities
Participates in negotiations with provider organizations to optimize pricing levels for SHC
Reviews and plans methods of payment to professional and institutional health care providers
Reviews and implements the fiscal year plan, departmental budgets and coordinates staff efforts to prepare such budgets and other necessary data to present to the Tribal Council
Obtains, as needed, consulting services for program planning, development, implementation and expertise in specialized fields
Provides the Tribal Council with professional research of operational data to assist its committees with decisions regarding the Health Center and its operations

Job Specifications:

Education & Experience
Essential:
Bachelor’s Degree in Health Care Administration, Business Administration, Public Administration, or related field or equivalent experience
10 years of progressive health center management experience
2 years of experience working with non-profit organizations and community groups serving ethnic minorities, seniors and low-income individuals

Desirable
Master’s Degree in Health Care Administration, Business Administration, Public Administration, or related field
Tribal Health Center experience

Skills & Knowledge :
Essential:
Thorough knowledge of Federal, State, local and private funding sources and regulations related to healthcare management
Thorough knowledge of fundraising strategies and principles of healthcare administration including personnel management, public relations, financial planning and budgeting
Ability to analyze and interpret data and make sound decisions
Ability to develop and execute business and operational strategies
Ability to interact effectively with internal and external contacts
Ability to conduct effective oral presentations
Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
Ability to provide effective leadership and guidance to staff
Ability to maintain professionalism and composure
Ability to maintain strict confidentiality
Ability to accept constructive criticism

jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

The mission matters. So do the people behind it. With advancing defense technology at our core, what sets us apart is a culture of collaboration, purpose, and impact. What is the mission?

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more— we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

What Does This Role Look Like

This position will support the THAAD Development Program Director as a deputy in managing over 750 employees across three primary Lockheed Martin sites, leading the THAAD engineering services infrastructure and the development of enhanced THAAD capabilities, ensuring resources are appropriately aligned and managed to support successful program execution. Program Management Director for THAAD Interceptor Development (~$150M/year sales and $100M/year in self investment execution) and deputy to the THAAD Development Program Director (~$400M/year in sales).

The position manages all engineering development scope for the THAAD Interceptor, advancing technology capability, resolving obsolescence and second sourcing.
The position delivers qualified THAAD Interceptor technical data packages ready for high rate production.
The position is responsible for development work that is critical path to $4B/year of THAAD Interceptor production sales.
The position advances THAAD Interceptor capability impacting the weapon systems ability to outpace the evolving threat and competition.

In this role you will have the following daily key responsibilities:

Managing the execution of THAAD development contracts and programs for cost, schedule, and technical aspects.
Interfacing with the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) and Army customers.
Overseeing proposal activities for development contracts
Leading organizational initiatives to increase deployment velocity and efficiency.

The information below reflects the standard job description for this position:

Directs all phases of programs from inception through completion. Responsible for coordinating subordinate employee recruitment, selection and training, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition/disciplinary actions. Responsible for the cost, schedule and technical performance of company programs or subsystems of major programs. Participates in the negotiation of contract and contract changes. Coordinates the preparation of proposals, business plans, proposal work statements and specifications, operating budgets and financial terms/conditions of contract. Acts as primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with customer to discuss cost, schedule, and technical performance. Establishes design concepts, criteria and engineering efforts for product research, development, integration and test. Develops new business or expands the product line with the customer. Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to master plans and schedules, identifies program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocation of resources or changing contractual specifications. Directs the work of employees assigned to the program from technical, manufacturing and administrative areas.

Basic Qualifications

To be effective, you will need to possess these basic qualifications:

Bachelors degree in a STEM or Business field,
Possess 10+ years’ experience leading projects, people, and operations for a large multidisciplinary workforce with salaried and hourly represented employees,
Development Program Management, Missile Hardware and Software Development experience,
Domain knowledge in Missile Development, Missile Defense, Advanced Electronics, Agile Software Development,
Demonstrated Full Spectrum Leadership skills,
You will need to be a US Citizen, and currently possess and be able to maintain a US SECRET clearance, with ability of obtain Top Secret clearance, to support this government contract, as well as successfully pass a drug and background check, in order to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Desired Skills

To be effective, ideally, you should also have:

Experience maintaining positive working relationships with industry and government customers
Proven ability to interface with company senior leadership and external customers at all levels
Strong executive presence, business acumen, including negotiation and conflict management skills
THAAD experience, and/or large weapon system level development leadership experience
Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice

Full-Time Salary Range: $180000.00 - $325000.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

Demonstrated success in building high performing operating teams
Demonstrated success in driving initiatives that yield strong results

Demonstrated ability to effectively coach and manage Treatment Center Directors, Clinical Supervisors and Directors.

Introduction

The Maryland Department of Labor is currently accepting applications from qualified candidates for an Executive Director position within the Division of Occupational and Professional Licensing. As a member of the Occupational and Professional Licensing Team, you can build a fulfilling career while enjoying a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental converge, paid time off (vacation and sick leave), participation in the State pension plan, supplemental retirement options, and membership in the Maryland State Employees Credit Union.

Resumes are accepted as additional information, however the application will be rejected unless it is not completed.

This is a Special Appointment position and serves at the pleasure of the Appointing Authority.

GRADE

19

LOCATION OF POSITION

100 S. Charles Street, Baltimore, Maryland 21201

Main Purpose of Job

The main purposes of this position are to enforce the regulations of the State Athletic Commission, to administer the office of the Commission, and to manage staff at Commissionsanctioned events. All purposes are directly linked to working to protect the safety of all competing contestants and to reflecting fairness and equity in all decisions rendered by the Commission.

POSITION DUTIES

Duties of this position include but are not limited to:

At Commission-sanctioned combative sports events: Supervise a staff of up to approximately 25 individuals -- including referees, judges, physicians and inspectors; enforce regulations; oversee contests; compile official data; respond to medical issues; and schedule and manage medical examinations and drug testing for contestants. Review, certify and approve the issuance of licenses; and serve as the official custodian of records for the Commission.
Convey, and exchange, information and critical data with licensees via the telephone, e-mail, U.S. mail and facsimile to enforce the regulations of the commission; prepare all required documents in preparation for the regulation of commission-sanctioned combative sports events; administrate the day-to-day management of the office; and serve as the principal liaison for all business negotiations with promoters involved in boxing, MMA and wrestling who are desirous of potentially doing business in, and holding events in, the State of Maryland.
Supervise the fiscal management of the Commission on a daily basis; supervise the preparation of the Commission budget for the review and approval of the Commissioner of O&P; devise and implement fiscal and administrative changes to promote efficiency and to reduce Commission costs; and account for all monies received by, and expended by, the Commission.
